components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single action colour; search, save, upload.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:#0067b1; color:#fff; border:0; border-radius:10px; padding:10px 16px; font:600 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(15 27 45 / 0.05), 0 1px 3px rgb(15 27 45 / 0.04); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#004f88; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #f2a900; outline-offset:0; box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #00205b; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined secondary action, e.g. Download CSV.

components.name: Postal Code Input
components.description: Text field with Clinical Blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; background:#fff; color:#0f1b2d; border:1px solid #848f9f; border-radius:10px; padding:10px 12px; font:400 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px rgb(15 27 45 / 0.04); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#626e7c; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:#0067b1; outline:3px solid #f2a900; outline-offset:0; box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #00205b; }

components.name: Site Header
components.description: Navy bar, wordmark tile, white nav links, Clinical Blue rule.
components.html:
CCARE-IDin partnership with SickKids
Community mapPublic health dashboard
components.css: .ds-header { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:24px; height:64px; padding:0 24px; background:#00205b; color:#fff; border-bottom:2px solid #0067b1; font-family:Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-mark { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; color:#fff; text-decoration:none; } .ds-tile { display:grid; place-items:center; width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:8px; background:#fff; color:#00205b; font-weight:700; font-size:14px; } .ds-mark b { display:block; font-size:15px; } .ds-mark small { display:block; font-size:12px; color:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.85); } .ds-nav { color:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.85); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:8px; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; } .ds-nav:hover { background:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); color:#fff; } .ds-active { background:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.15); color:#fff; }

components.name: Virus Filter Chip
components.description: Toggle pill with virus colour dot; on and off states.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:0 12px; border-radius:9999px; border:0; background:transparent; color:#626e7c; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #e2e7ee; font:500 14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { color:#0f1b2d; } .ds-on { background:#fff; color:#0f1b2d; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #c9d1dc, 0 1px 3px rgb(15 27 45 / 0.04); } .ds-dot { width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:9999px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: White, softly lifted container with hairline ring.
components.html:
Results are de-identified

Names, exact ages and dates are removed.
components.css: .ds-card { background:#fff; border-radius:16px; padding:24px; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgb(226 231 238 / 0.7), 0 1px 2px rgb(15 27 45 / 0.05), 0 1px 3px rgb(15 27 45 / 0.04); font-family:Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin:0; font-size:16px; font-weight:600; color:#0f1b2d; } .ds-card p { margin:4px 0 0; font-size:14px; color:#556274; }

components.name: Activity Badge
components.description: Signature: Ember dots + level word + trend; never colour alone.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-family:Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dots { display:flex; gap:4px; } .ds-dots i { width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:9999px; border:1.5px solid; box-sizing:border-box; } .ds-badge b { font-weight:600; color:#0f1b2d; } .ds-trend { font-size:14px; color:#556274; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Radio group on a muted track; active segment lifts.
components.css: .ds-seg { display:flex; padding:4px; border-radius:10px; background:#f0f3f7; font-family:Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seg button { flex:1; border:0; background:transparent; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:8px; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; color:#556274; cursor:pointer; } .ds-seg button:hover { color:#0f1b2d; } .ds-seg .ds-seg-on { background:#fff; color:#0f1b2d; box-shadow:0 4px 12px -2px rgb(15 27 45 / 0.08), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(15 27 45 / 0.05); }

narrative.overview: CARE-ID should read like a trusted public-health notice pinned up at a school: navy authority at the top, plain words underneath, and nothing that raises the pulse without a reason. The system is quiet on purpose. A cool grey page, white cards lifted by hairline rings and faint shadows, one blue for actions, and a single warm ramp reserved for virus activity. Colour is almost never decorative. When something is orange it means "virus activity". When something is blue it means "you can act here".
keyCharacteristics: A navy header bar with a thin Clinical Blue rule beneath it marks the product as an institution.
White cards on a cool grey canvas, softly lifted.
One warm, ordinal Ember ramp for activity levels. Every activity colour is paired with dots and a word.
A fixed colour for each virus, the same in every chart, chip and legend.
Inter throughout, with tabular figures for numbers.
The focus ring is amber, the system's only loud colour.

rules.name: The Data Owns Warmth Rule
rules.body: Orange and red tones belong to virus activity. Interface chrome (buttons, headers, badges, alerts other than warnings) never uses the Ember ramp, so a warm colour on screen always means "virus".

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every activity level pairs its colour with filled dots (1, 2 or 3) and a word. Every chart line carries an end label. Every virus chip and summary row pairs its colour dot with the virus name. A design that encodes meaning only in hue is wrong.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Clinical Blue means "interactive". Don't use it for decoration, large fills or data, except in the dashboard's positivity blues, which stay inside the map.

rules.name: The Weight Not Face Rule
rules.body: Never introduce a second typeface for emphasis. Step up the weight (400 → 600 → 700) or the size.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any column, KPI or tooltip that shows numbers uses tabular figures so values align and don't jitter when filters change.

rules.name: The Three Steps Rule
rules.body: There are exactly three elevations: card, raised and overlay. Don't invent a fourth. If something needs more emphasis, change its position or colour, not its shadow.

dos: Do pair every activity colour with dots and a word, using ActivityBadge. Never render a bare Ember swatch as the only signal outside a legend.
Do use the virus colours from src/lib/viruses.ts and the activity and positivity colours from src/lib/display.ts, never new literals.
Do use the hatch, and the words "Not enough data" or "Too few tests", for suppressed figures.
Do keep primary text in Ink and supporting text in Ink Muted. Use Ink Subtle for hints and metadata, and never anything lighter for text.
Do use the three named shadows (card, raised, overlay) and the radius scale above.
Do keep Clinical Blue for interactive elements and the navy for identity.
donts: Don't use the SickKids logo or invent a mark. The header uses a wordmark only until approved co-branding artwork exists.
Don't colour interface chrome with the Ember ramp, or use red, orange or alarm styling to dramatise activity levels.
Don't introduce a second typeface or a decorative display face.
Don't add a fourth elevation level or grey-black shadows.
Don't show case counts or test counts on public (community) surfaces. Activity levels only.
Don't hard-code new hex values in components. Add a token in globals.css, or a data colour in display.ts or viruses.ts.
